verdict.rationale: The pack documents on-device inference, NPU acceleration, and hosted cloud models that run on RunAnywhere's hardware. Nothing describes reserved or dedicated capacity, concurrency handling, or steady throughput across multiple agents or sessions. Running cloud models on vendor hardware is not the same as reserving capacity, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
